expectations.note: With Cassette selected, the live Settings semantics and screenshot show screen followed by immersive; the cassette variant row is not the next row and remains hidden much farther down.

Repeated on-screen activation cycled the screen setting through polo, dot, void, cassette, and spectrum, and the displayed screen value tracked the runtime setting; a direct screen call also produced a matching polo row.
The live cassette variant control still responded to on-screen activation, and direct cassettevariant calls changed the displayed cassette variant value (including Minimal) in the structural capture.

Non-cassette states did not inject a cassette-only row, and spectrum/dot controls were present and tappable, but the full all-screen preservation check was not satisfied: Polo-specific controls were absent in the live sheet after switching to Polo.

The candidate-delivered cassette screenshot is the main playback screen rather than the Settings sheet; the fresh Settings screenshot shows Cassette but does not show an adjacent cassette variant row.

A structural semantics capture exists, but it corroborates the failure: screen is followed by immersive and the cassette variant appears only at a later hidden index, not the claimed adjacent placement.

The live sheet retained the unrelated MODE, LOOK, transport, browser, full-screen, UI-scale, and LIBRARY rows in their prior order, and representative unrelated controls (screen and visualizer settings) remained tappable.
Runtime inspection after repeatedly opening settings and switching screens found the app live, with zero overflow reports and no runtime error state.
